name: cynosure-desktop
description: Cynosure - local AI agent with tools, memories, and reasoning capabilities

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,electron -c blue,green "pnpm --filter cynosure-web dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron-vite dev"
scripts.build:deps: pnpm --filter cynosure-web build && pnpm --filter cynosure-server build
scripts.package: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run package:skip-deps
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run package:skip-deps --linux
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run package:skip-deps --win
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run package:skip-deps --mac
scripts.package:skip-deps: pnpm run build && node scripts/prepare-server-deps.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
